Paxos Made Simple

The Paxos algorithm, when presented in plain English, is very simple.

Paxos lets a set of processes choose a single value even when messages are lost.

Leslie Lamport first described Paxos in a paper about a fictional parliament.

Proposers, acceptors and learners are the three roles in the algorithm.

Consensus algorithms such as Paxos underpin replicated state machines.
